Laguna Park 2

Townhouse in Laguna
HomePhuket PropertyTownhouses for SaleLaguna Park 2

Photos from the Thailand-Property listing provided by Laguna Property; page also shows other Laguna projects, only matching modern townhouse images used. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Laguna Park 2 is a three-storey townhouse and villa enclave by Laguna Property beside the Laguna resort complex in Choeng Thale, completed in 2023. Owners get Laguna resort privileges such as club membership and shuttle access.

Laguna Park 2: key facts

  • Laguna Park 2 is a townhouses and villas in Laguna, Phuket, developed by Laguna Property.
  • Units: 2–5 bedrooms, 318–550 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as 2023.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold / Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿20,800,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Phuket International Airport (about 25 minutes, driving); Patong Beach (about 30 minutes, driving).
  • More projects by Laguna Property in our catalogue: Bellaguna Golf Residences Hibiscus, Laguna Lake Residences Aster.

Facilities & amenities

  • Swimming pool
  • Fitness centre
  • Rest area
  • Parking
  • 24-hour security
  • CCTV
  • Restaurants and bar
  • XANA Beach Club
  • Free shuttle bus and ferry between Laguna resorts
  • Sanctuary Club membership
  • 5 years free Laguna Phuket Golf Club membership
